text:
maria (PM): Quick sync on Private Deploy lanes. Goal: get a defensible GA plan that covers customer-managed networking, an upgrade path that preserves egress identity, and clear launch acceptance per lane.

alex (Eng): We keep getting stuck on egress IP preservation. Two pragmatic paths: sticky SNAT gateway in-customer (installer) or an egress-relay we host. Both require tradeoffs.

netops-jordan: Sticky SNAT via a lightweight appliance in the customer VPC avoids relay privacy issues but adds ops for customers. Relay hosted by us reduces customer work but raises compliance flags.

security-elena: Relay is a blocker until we complete a privacy impact assessment. Need legal + data-class mapping.

lisa (Field): Customers with strict firewall windows (quarterly) need IP preservation or they'll delay upgrades. ACME, Nimbus, and Hylas flagged this.

sam (SRE): For "zero-downtime" define measurable targets: <1% errors during upgrade, KV miss rate <0.5%, rollback <10min. Canary automation must validate these.

alex (Eng): Proposed road lanes: 1) Minimal installer GA (fast): offline bundle, basic telemetry, KMS docs. 2) Upgrade-aware operator (Beta): KV hot-transfer, canary rollout, feature flag. 3) VPC-handoff (scope Q4): IP-preserve modes + peering playbook.

maria (PM): Sounds reasonable. We need acceptance criteria per lane. Alex, can you scope the operator shim spike?

alex (Eng): Yes. I'll produce a POC showing KV streaming and node swap within 2 weeks. Will include a demo script and smoke test that measures P50 token latency delta <10ms.

netops-jordan: I'll draft a short risk matrix for the three egress patterns (SNAT appliance, BGP, hosted-relay) including operational and legal risk. 1 week.

security-elena: I'll scope the privacy review for hosted-relay and start legal engagement. Expect 3 weeks for a decision path.

lisa (Field): I'll collate the top 8 customers who require IP preservation and map their upgrade windows. Need this to schedule Beta invites.

sam (SRE): I'll draft canary runbook and automation: traffic split, metrics thresholds, auto-rollback triggers.

deploy-bot: Reminder: gate merges with feature-flag and opt-in Beta tag.

maria (PM): Decision: ship Minimal installer GA first (2 sprints), operator shim Beta next (4 sprints), VPC-handoff after security/legal signoff. Action items: Alex POC (2w), Netops risk matrix (1w), Security review kickoff (Elena, 3w), Field customer mapping (Lisa, 1w), SRE canary playbook (Sam, 2w).

lisa (Field): Also include a documented rollback checklist and SE oncall coverage for upgrade windows. Field can only sell with a <2h support SLA during upgrades.

alex (Eng): Question: implement an installer flag like IP_PRESERVE_MODE=true as Beta-only? Less invasive for GA.

maria (PM): Yes, Beta-only flag seems safe. We'll document limitations.

sam (SRE): We need load-test acceptance before GA sign-off.

maria (PM): Agreed. I'll publish an RFC with lanes, ACs, timeline, and owners by EOD. If anything blocks your actions, DM me.

netops-jordan: Note: single-AZ customers may prefer relay; multi-AZ customers prefer appliance. Ill add guidance to the matrix.

alex (Eng): I'll include a short script for the demo: kubectl patch to annotate rollout + kv-transfer job.

maria (PM): Thanks all. RFC link will follow here. :rocket:
